class.name: VehicleHeating
class.brief_description: Represents and configures the vehicle's train heating (Clima) power source.
class.description: [VehicleHeating] wraps the FIZ [code]Clima:[/code] section, which selects and configures the power source used to heat the train (an onboard generator, an accumulator, a power cable from another vehicle, and so on).

members.member: [code]Clima:HGeneratorEngine[/code] Type of engine driving the heating generator, when [member heating_source] is Generator. Only [constant VehicleEngine.MAIN] is actually supported by the mover today.
[code]Clima:HGeneratorMaxRPM[/code] Upper end of the generator's working RPM range.
[code]Clima:HGeneratorMinRPM[/code] Lower end of the generator's working RPM range.
[code]Clima:HMaxVoltage[/code] Maximum voltage of the electric heating circuit, in volts.
[code]Clima:HPowerTrans[/code] Form of energy delivered over the power cable, when [member heating_source] is PowerCable (electric or steam).
[code]Clima:Heating[/code] Power source for the train heating circuit.
